_comment: SAMPLE DATA — 'About me' texts. IDs must be unique. Keep texts short enough to fit a phone card (roughly 40 words max).

entries.text: Greetings. I enjoy long glides through low Earth orbit. Looking for a carbon-unit to share atmospheric pressure and mutually pretend our internal organs are normal. Swipe right if your exoskeleton is intact.
Looking for a sweet alien to go to Mars with.
Three hearts, zero commitment issues. Well, maybe one per heart.
I have been told my tentacles are my best feature. My mother disagrees.
Recently out of a 400-year relationship. Ready to try again.
Fluent in 3,000 languages, still bad at texting back.
Just here to see what the algorithm thinks I deserve.
If you can survive my home planet's gravity, you can survive my family.
